papers.title: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation
papers.abstract: Semantic Task Completion Video Generation evaluates outcome achievement and semantic grounding. The work introduces SemComp-Data covering six domains and SemComp-Bench, a VLM-based evaluation protocol.

papers.title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
papers.abstract: A closed-loop embodied harness that evolves runtime critics and recovery skills online, achieving state-of-the-art success on robot benchmarks LIBERO-Pro (90.8%) and RoboCasa (93.6%).

papers.title: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist
papers.abstract: An end-to-end AI scientist conducting multidisciplinary research from heterogeneous raw evidence including images, signals, audio, video, and 3D structures, completing full research workflows.

papers.title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL
papers.abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework where decoupled models derive rewards from peers. Achieves 3.0-8.6% gains across LLM benchmarks and 2.3-7.2% for VLMs without ground-truth labels.

papers.title: Training Chemical Plausibility-Aware Large Language Models for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
papers.abstract: Top-K prompting paradigm for diverse reaction prediction. Trains C3LM on 45.6 million verified reactions achieving state-of-the-art on OOD URSA-expert-2026 benchmark.

papers.title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification
papers.abstract: Data-free white-box method detecting model ancestry through weight-space signatures. Achieves AUROC=1.0 separating fine-tuned descendants from independent models, running 76x faster than baselines.

papers.title: Decision-Metric Alignment in Latent World Models: Diagnostics and Action-Conditioned Objectives for MPC Planning
papers.abstract: Analyzes whether latent distance preserves real-cost rankings in JEPA-style models. Proposes DA-LeWM with action-conditioned objectives improving geometry for Euclidean-cost MPC planning.

papers.title: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget: Adaptive Popularity for LLM Unlearning
papers.abstract: AdaPop method combines token confidence with popularity-dependent exponents for LLM unlearning. Reduces forgotten content leakage ~5x under paraphrased queries and ~1.6x under adversarial reformulations.

papers.title: Scaling Creative Writing Beyond Story-Centric Data with Attribute-Guided Genre Expansion
papers.abstract: Framework leveraging genre attributes enforces structural conventions across 13 creative formats. Constructs 50K-example corpus and demonstrates improved performance on out-of-distribution writing benchmarks.

papers.title: SoftVTBench: A Deformation-Aware Visuo-Tactile Dataset and Benchmark for Deformable-Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Visuo-tactile dataset with 4,000 expert demonstrations synchronized at 20 Hz with FEM states. Introduces Deformation-aware Success Rate metric revealing interaction quality gaps in existing policies.

cc_updates.body: Added a `keybindingFlavor` setting: set it to `"readline"` to make Ctrl+W in the prompt delete back to the previous whitespace, as in Bash; the default (`"classic"`) is unchanged. Plugin marketplaces: `headersHelper` on a url marketplace or a catalog entry runs a command that mints HTTP headers (e.g. a short-lived token) for catalog and same-origin archive fetches. A catalog entry's `headersHelper` runs only when you install or update that plugin, after its command is shown; `claude plugin install/update` ask `[y/N]` (or pass `-y`). Added `claude self-hosted-runner --defer-shutdown-max-min <minutes>`: on SIGTERM, keep serving attached sessions, park what is left after that many minutes, then exit.

Fixed prompt caching for sessions using an LLM gateway or custom base URL. Added a built-in "Concise" output style: Claude leads with results and skips preamble and narration, while doing the work just as thoroughly. Select it under Output style in /config.

Added `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL` environment variable: sets the model new sessions start on, while a `/model` pick still overrides it and persists across restarts (unlike `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`). Added `notify_when_idle` to cross-session `SendMessage`: ask another Claude Code session on this machine to send one notice when it next goes idle — opt-in, one-shot, no polling (macOS and Linux). Sandbox: on macOS, wildcard read-deny rules (e.g. `**/.env`) now take precedence inside allowed read regions, cover matched directories' contents, and can't be bypassed by renaming the denied file.
